  Having slowly become more and more roboticised while also becoming increasingly involved in a number of dodgy dealings and nefarious schemes, Noel believes it is only a matter of time before he ends up on Sam Slade's bounty-hunting radar and has decided to pre-empt such an eventuality.

  When Sam puts on the VR headset he immediately becomes trapped within the virtual world and must fight for his life for real. Eventually realising what has happened, Stogie patches Hoagy into the system in an attempt to assist Sam, but Hoagy's inferior AI fragments, causing the robot to appear in-game in a number of locations as a levitating head and also have some of his memories manifest, such as that of Sam's Robo-Meter, Cutie.

  It transpires that Noel Skum has also patched himself into the system remotely, in order to direct the game's virtual droids and generally keep an eye on things. To escape from the digital realm, Sam must search for and defeat Noel's robotic avatar, thus completing the game and destroying Noel in both worlds.

417637.overview:
SBOT is a high-tech android with truly exceptional capabilities, it has been built with all the necessary elements to repel any type of attack, with a high-intensity photonic laser as a defense element.

The EARTH is about to be attacked by an alien ship hidden on the dark side of the Moon, that is why SBOT has been sent from the blue planet, EARTH, it has traveled to the Moon our asteroid in which in its Inside is an Alien Mothership whose mission is to destroy the EARTH.

Our intelligence base on EARTH has detected that the ship consists of several areas in which we will have to locate the necessary components to enter the escape area, next to it we have an area where the deposit is located, we will have to escape in our second ship that was captured years ago, locating the escape zone will be the key to our success in the mission.

After that and upon arrival on earth, they inform SBOT that they have stolen a stellar map which they have broken into several parts that will need to be located, the map with all the parts will allow us to avoid new attacks on our civilization in the future and that SBOT can take that well-deserved rest to replenish energy.

417854.overview:
SQIJ'D! (also called SQIJ'D!: Sqij and the Tree of Ener) is an unofficial sequel to one of the most infamous ZX Spectrum games.

The game was developed by John Blythe and Graz and published by Monument Microgames on January 3, 2020.

The bird is back, and not all is well in paradise!

The Ener tree that Sqij created, all those years ago, has enveloped the planet, 
demanding you bring it the food it needs to thrive. But you swear that you'll 
not be its lackey forever. You have a plan. One that will set you up as the 
most powerful bird in the universe!

418336.overview: Since the dawn of time, two hidden castes have coexisted on Earth, unbeknownst to mankind. The Guardians, who dwell outside the boundaries of time and protect life on our planet, and the Marauders, who relentlessly pursue the Guardians across the ages, ruthlessly seizing whatever they desire. Locked in an eternal conflict, these castes have upheld a balance between good and evil. But one fateful day, Serafima emerges as the last surviving Guardian. If she falls, the Marauders will remain trapped in their respective ages, but the future of Earth will be shrouded in uncertainty. Serafima resolves to fight until her last breath, defeat her foes, and ultimately save Earth.

418363.overview:
In order to succeed in making your team league and cup champions you must answer questions.

You can't select your team but you can train them instead by answering questions. If you get the question correct then they improve, answer wrong and they get worse. To play a game against a team you have to answer questions as well. If they're attacking, get the question right and it's saved. Get it wrong and they score. Likewise if you are attacking, right means you score, wrong and it's saved.

You start in Division 4 (League 2 here in 2012) and work your way up to Division 1 (Premiership). You also enter the F.A. Cup (still the same) and League Cup (Carling Cup). The game is just text, no graphics here. There are around 2000 questions in the database.

419780.overview:
Savage Princess! The name strikes fear into the heart of even the bravest knight! Take the role of Princess Ava as she rescues herself from her kidnappers!

Explore the castle, solve puzzles, and kill your enemies in this game for the ZX Spectrum; brought to you by the creator of "In the Walls of Eryx" and "The Wicker Woman", this game is sure to warm your retrogaming cockles.

420021.overview:
Spi Droid (also known as Spi-Droid) is a game in which you control a ball that has to go around a spooky maze (a bit similar to games like Marble Madness and SpinDizzy) in which the goal is to maneuver around the maze without falling off the sides. The game was developed and published by Vinsoft in 1989.

You also have to contend with obstacles like larger balls, and an alien spaceship.

420293.overview:
STARFIRE: RID THE GALAXY OF THE XTARDAN BATTLE CRUISERS - A GAME OF STRATEGY AND SKILL by Martyn Charles Davis.

You are Commander of the only remaining EARTH SPACE AGENCY ship in the entire galaxy. The rest of your fleet has been wiped out by a powerful alien force leaving you to navigate the galaxy and destroy the alien fighters single-handed.

The future of civilization depends on you. You must succeed!

420786.overview: A street-wise football simulator where the teams are rough and the rules don't apply. Two of the meanest gangs this side of the Bronx take to the streets of a downtown ghetto to kick and fight their way to the goal. All the features of Street Football plus all the features of a mean beat-em-up - and more! The field of action is a fully detailed downtown street - cars, buildings, pavements, wasteground, potholes and walls all have to be negotiated before you can get near the goal. The teams foul and fight each other to gain the advantage. They may even decide to play with a tin can if the ball bursts!

421186.overview: The plants are poisonous, the other insects are ravenous cannibals. The only things that  aren’t hostile are the worms in the garden. Few can survive this multi-speed action packed arcade game.

421418.overview: Fly your one-man fighter over hostile enemy terrain  avoiding air mines, heat-seeking missiles, Quasar pulses and other aliens' deterrents. Guide your craft over the mountainous landscape and under  treacherous cave ceilings. To stay alive you must use your maximum potential strike force or die!

422210.overview:
Savage Island is the only multi-part game in Scott Adams' adventure series, all of which have a very similar parser and interface. At the completion of this game, players receive a password which allows part two to be played. The Savage Island games are also probably the most difficult adventures in the series!

The player begins trapped on a small remote island in the ocean, which is facing a hurricane and also has an active volcano. The player can cross a river, and will also need to explore a cave network. Items are often found by running through the sand with one's hands.

The island holds a great secret, which will not be discovered until both parts of the game have been completed.

424361.overview:
SILVERWOLF..... it is 5000 years ago in the west of England - then known as Abolan and the inheritor of the civilisation, riches and magical knowledge of the mighty island continent of Caire.. the legendary Atlantis of myth and legend.

The country is ruled by the usurper MORVEN or rather by the power behind the throne, her consort LORD FEAR. The true heiress, Princess Mayanna, has been slain but her closet friends have travelled through time itself to bring her back to life in the form of her reincarnation- a shy retiring schoolgirl known as Petra Stone.
Before Petra can become Mayanna, she must drink from the 'Cup of Memory' on the Sacred Mountain. For then and only then can the Princess's 'alter-ego' be reborn. Only then can SILVERWOLF be reborn! Only then, aided by the enchanted sword which is presently hidden in the great lake island, can Petra Stone become Princess Mayanna.

The group of friends splits into two smaller parties - Thunder and Uisce seek the sword whilst Rahiyana and Whirlwind take Petra to the Sacred Mountain. However all is not that simple because the "Unholy Swarm' are hard on their heels and LORD FEAR has given orders that they must be stopped at all costs. So both parties must
caution haste with vigilance and ensure they avoid the 'Unholy Swarm' at all times.

The player can become any one of the four main characters and the different abilities of four characters will enable the player to make progress throughout the game. Each characters abilities will be called to a good use at different times so choose which one to play wisely.

RAHIYANA:Known as the 'Golden Archer', she is the leader of the four, an experienced warrior who is cool, thoughtful, dignified and somewhat humourless. She carries a golden bow which fires arrows of light thunderbolts which can dazzle any enemy, destroy creatures of 'dark magic' and lighten the darkest night. She invokes the lightning by means of the cry "HAYA DYANA". 

THUNDER:She stands over seven foot tall and possesses astonishing strength. She is gentle and good-humoured, but totally untiring in battle.

WHIRLWIND:A young girl with uncanny speed of foot, she can outrace a galloping horse and her speed makes her extremely dangerous in a 'sword-fight'. She is emotional and impetuous.

UISCE: She is an 'imp', an elfin 'shape-changer', who can take on the form of any living thing. She is pert, lively and exceedingly quick thinking.
In either part of the game the player can become one or other of the FOUR main characters.

To do this simply type in BECOME THUNDER or BECOME UTSCE and it will be done. The player can also change to another form when in the role of UISCE.... for example to change to a squirrel simply type in TURN INTO A SQUIRREL when playing the role of UISCE. It is also possible to engage the other characters in conversation, so to do this simply type in whatever it is you wish to say in the following form...

438362.overview:
Young Argos tries to free his people from the tyranny of Master Ghraul, who has ruled them through fear for years, helped by creatures from the very depths of hell.

Legends tell that whoever learns the spells contained within the Sacred Book will obtain such magic power that he will be able to face the most vile creatures from the underworld.

Some consider it a childish tale, but Argos, aware of the legend, has taken it upon himself to brave uncountable perils to reach the heart of the Dark Castle and learn the spells within the Sacred Book.

It is written that the only way to reach the Castle is through an underground pass that begins in the depths of the Forest of Silence and crosses the Cavern of Fire.

Guide our young sorcerer apprentice in his first adventure through dark forests and the insides of caverns brimming with danger, in his journey to infiltrate the Dark Castle, where the three fragments of the Sacred Book lie.

Learn your first spells from the ancient texts and return safe and sound to continue your destiny: becoming a top notch sorcerer and, finally, defeating the Black Master.

439967.overview: In SUPERPOWER each player runs the intelligence agency of a major world power. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to protect your power's assets in a continent of developing countries. You also advice on new investments and undermine the schemes of other players (or the SPECTRUM). Starting wars, assassination and enginerring coups are just some of the 'dirty tricks' available. SUPERPOWER is for 1 to 6 players.

443238.overview: After the tiring events of Savage Princess, Princess Ava decanted to the pub, where several libations were imbibed. Now, in Savage Princess 2, we find her sleeping off a well-earned hangover, when she is rudely awakened by Eldritch dreams, and the sounds of screaming outside. Cthulhu has woken from his slumber! Even as her home town of Kilbaddie burns around her, Ava wants nothing more than 40 winks, and sets off in search of the betentacled behemoth that disrupts her sleep.

446818.overview:
SPACE SCAN (also known as Star Search) is an educational astronomy program for the 48K ZX Spectrum:

Discover the key constellations and stars of the Northern skies! A must for every would-be astronomer.

* Learn to recognise constellations 
* Explore the major stars and nebulae 
* Test your knowledge with a space quiz 
* Astro-glossary 
* Quality graphics 
* Print out your space data 
* Microdrive compatible

Developed by Blackboard Software and published by Macmillan Software in 1985.

447560.overview: A compendium of 7 Christmas themed mini-games

447848.overview: You are unexpectedly summoned by "M" the head of the Secret Service. After miss Cashcoin has shown you into the office, "M" outlines the situation. A jetfighter has mysteriously disappeared whilest on a training mission. No wreckage has been found but it is known that the plane was carrying a nuclear missile. Your task is to locate the plane and its deadly cargo, and diffuse the missile.

448237.overview: Use the crane to grab the cars and stack them up. Make sure you do it in the right order though or they'll fall down.

448936.overview:
Samurai Warrior is an adventure game set in 13th Century Japan where you take on the role of a Samurai who must survive and reach a certain amount of points depending on the skill level (1500 on the ZX81) to win the game over a number of periods. There are also a number of other Samurai looking to defeat you and will challenge you on regular occasions which can be accepted or refused. You are presented with a number of options to play the game and these include challenge another Samurai, seek out bandits, offer assistance to a village, hunt for food, committ Seppuko and finally see your status report.

You have various stats that need increasing and these include overall status, reputation, physical condition and hunger. You must perform tasks and accept challenges to increase these stats which will increase your points total. If you are close to your total points then committing Seppuko (killing yourself) awards you points and if you pass the reqiured points total then you have won the game. Before the game there are seven levels of play (1-7) to choose from.

449072.overview:
As the title indicates, this compilation contains three Star Wars games:

Star Wars
Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
Star Wars: Return of the Jedi

449179.overview:
As part of their efforts to raise money for the undernourished children of Africa, Bob Geldof's Band-Aid Trust collaborated with Quicksilva to produce compilations of games. These were released for several home computers, each featuring a largely different roster of games, as well as the Band Aid single "Do They Know It's Christmas?". The Spectrum version contains:

Spellbound(Beyond)
Starbike(Edge)
Kokotoni Wilf(Elite)
The Pyramid(Fantasy)
Horace Goes Ski-ing(Melbourne House)
Gilligan's Gold(Ocean)
Ant Attack(Quicksilva)
3D Tank Duel(Realtime)
Jack and the Beanstalk(Thor)
Sorcery(Virgin)

449569.overview:
Demon Lord is a traditional text adventure. You tell the game what you want to do via a textual interface and the parser is based on verb / noun input.

Th upper half of the screen is used for illustrations and the lower half for the descriptive text and the input.

You control the last of the Knights of King Arthur's round table and the objective is to find and rescue the King and kill the Demon Lord who is holding him.

The game comes in two parts filling 96KB of RAM, the first part is Fortress of Fear, the second Forbidden Forest.

450038.overview: Stomp is an arcade action game released in 1985 for the ZX Spectrum 48K. Developed by DK'Tronics Ltd, the game offers a gameplay experience that is both challenging and entertaining. Stomp can be played using the keyboard or a Kempston joystick. The objective of the game is to navigate through various levels, avoiding obstacles and enemies, while stomping on platforms to progress. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, Stomp provides hours of fun for players of all ages.

450876.overview:
This compilation contains the following four games:* The Way of the Tiger

Barry McGuigan World Championship Boxing
Beach Head II
Rescue on Fractalus!

451057.overview:
Screen Heroes is a compilation of games by Ocean which are all based on films or television series'. This compilation was released in conjunction with Dixons, a UK retailer of home electrical goods that at one time included computers, consoles and games. The games in this compilation are;* Rambo: First Blood Part II

Miami Vice
Frankie Goes to Hollywood
Highlander
Street Hawk
Knight Rider
Daley Thompson's Super-Test

451082.overview:
The Soccer Squad is a 1989 compilation pack published by Gremlin Graphics Software.  It contains four previously released football/soccer games (both action-based and management simulations)

The games include:

1. Footballer of the Year
2. Roy of the Rovers
3. Gary Lineker's Superskills
4. Gary Lineker's Superstar Soccer

451119.overview:
Summer Gold is a compilation of the following six games:

10th Frame
Beach Head II
Bruce Lee
Dambusters
Impossible Mission
Rebel Planet

451120.overview:
Golf is a 1 - 2 player golf game for the ZX Spectrum.

Based upon the Old Course at St Andrews, each hole has a brief description. Played from a top-down perspective, each stroke the player chooses the direction from 360°, as well as the club and power level. Each stroke can be set as straight, fade, or hook. The direction and distance of the ball is then displayed on the screen. Dangers include bunkers and water traps. After landing on the green, the screen zooms upon the green, and the player must putt. The number of strokes is calculated across nine holes.

451121.overview:
Star Soccer is a football game played through text input. The game is designed for two players and doesn't feature any AI, although it is possible for one player to control both teams. In the original ZX81 version it's only possible to play single matches with no options for cups, leagues or tournaments. There are in total 24 teams to choose from. Side A of the cassette features twelve English league teams, while side B features twelve international teams from the 1982 World Cup. The ZX Spectrum differs in that it does not feature single matches. Instead the English side features a super league of eight teams (including three Scottish teams) while the World Cup side is a replay of the finals, starting with the quarter finals. The ZX Spectrum version also allows the player to choose formations before games.

The game is played using three commands: P for passing, R for running and S for shooting. This means that to make a pass the player types P followed by the number of the player to receive it. When using the run command the player also has to enter the distance of the run. If a pass or shot is intercepted by a member of the opposing team, it's the second player's turn to attack. There are no commands for defensive actions. A 2D top down view shows all the action on the pitch.

452411.overview:
Select 1 is a compilation of twelve full priced games.

The games in this compilation are;

Side 1: Hunchback, Space Intruders, Mr. Wimpy, Kong, Transversion, Missile Defence

Side 2: Pool, Denis Through the Drinking Glass, Moon Buggy, Spectres, Meteor Storm, Time-Gate

453032.overview:
Stars on the 128 is a compilation of the following four ZX Spectrum games enhanced for 128K machines:

Daley Thompson's Super-Test
International Match Day
The NeverEnding Story
Yie Ar Kung-Fu

454152.overview: Stanley and the Wallbangers is a simple1-player  action maze game for the ZX Spectrum. It was developed by William Mitchell and published by Software Liason in 1985.

454590.overview:
Supersnails is a light cycle game similar to the arcade classic Tron. Players need to race their way into freedom, but playing as a trained race snail, represented as white lines against a blue background. The game can be played against another human player or the computer.

The snails leave behind a trail and the goal is to make the opponent crash by trapping them or by forcing them into a wall or a trail. When this is done, a hole opens up in a wall and the snail can move on to a new level.

455213.overview:
In the distant future, a war is raging between humans and machines.  

The machines try to change the destiny of humans, sending a robot to the past, which will be responsible for eliminating the mother of the resistance leader, when he has not yet been born. 

In a suicide mission, humans will infiltrate the Skynet base, once there they will send a person to the past, but the mission becomes complicated and everyone is exterminated except for a single soldier, Kyle Reese must try to use that time machine and travel to the year 1984 to fulfill his mission. 

To do this, you must find the nine chips that are needed to activate the time room and reach it, without dying in the attempt.

455382.overview:
A brand new game for the ZX Spectrum
The cartoon character from Down the Pipe now stars in his own horror shoot-em-up.
The little guy is literally scared s#$%less 
Battling through 5 full levels of nasties, each with its own theme and Boss to defeat. This improved Version 2.0 now contains much more Beeper music from utz, Tufty and the Prince of Darkness himself, Ozzy !

456249.overview:
In this game you control a robot and you have to activate all of the lightbulbs on each level by driving over them with your warm plasma field while avoiding the various nasties on screen. 

There are 40 different levels to test your skills and things gradually get harder as some of the lightbulbs you have already lit may flicker off again, forcing you to go back and light them again.  Extra lives are available and you will need them as you have no weapons to protect yourself.

457277.overview: Autostopista Galáctico is an early arcade-style game released in 1983 for the ZX Spectrum by Ventamatic. In this game, you control a small character trying to hitchhike through space, avoiding obstacles and hostile alien creatures. The gameplay focuses on dodging hazards and navigating moving platforms or vehicles to progress from one side of the screen to the other. It is heavily inspired by classic arcade games like Frogger, but set in a science-fiction universe. The graphics are simple, colorful, and typical of early Spectrum titles, offering fast-paced, reflex-based action rather than deep story or puzzles.

457382.overview: Shadows of the Past is an Adventure game, developed and published by Compass Software, which was released in Europe in 1990.

458395.overview:
The Story

Planet Hairtooine is under attack by the vile mutant Empire
You are our only hope of obliterating this threat
Once again our  Hairy friend must save the day in this fast paced side-scrolling shoot-em-up
Blast your way to success and be the Hero you was born to be
Good Luck, SuperHair!

CONTROLS

KEYBOARD 

 O - LEFT    P - RIGHT  Q - UP     A - DOWN  SPACE or M to FIRE LAZERS

JOYSTICK

SINCLAIR

459710.overview:
A U.S. Gold Master Games label compilation of 4 games originally released as individual titles by Adventure International.

All 4 games are single player text adventures.

Buckaroo Banzai (aka The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai across the 8th Dimension): by Phillip Case, Kem McNair and Scott Adams. It was converted to the BBC Micro by Brian Howart and originally released in 1987. Fifteenth game in the Scott Adams Adventure series.

Pirate Adventure: by Scott and Alexis Adams. It was converted to the BBC Micro by Brian Howart and Cliff Ogden and originally released in 1984. Second game in the Scott Adams Adventure series.

Strange Odyssey: by Scott Adams. Two BBC Micro conversions were made; one by Mak Jukic and another by Brian Howart and Cliff Ogden, with both originally released in 1984. Sixth game in the Scott Adams Adventure series.

Voodoo Castle: by Scott and Alexis Adams. It was converted to the BBC Micro by Brian Howart and Cliff Ogden and originally released in 1984. Fourth game in the Scott Adams Adventure series.

462247.overview:
Sharpshooter is a fixed-screen shooter for the ZX Spectrum. It is a clone/variant of the 1980 classic arcade game, Carnival.

It was developed by J.K. Cope and published by Kobrahsoft in 1987.

462288.overview: Shift Shaft is an action based dice board game for the ZX Spectrum. It was developed and published by Cases Computer Simulations in 1985.

462293.overview:
The Shining is a public domain action horror game based on the Stephen King novel, and Stanley Kubrick film (starring Jack Nicholson) of the same name.

It was developed and released by Francesco Forte on July 1, 2020.

The game has both English and Italian language options.

462361.overview: A text adventure, and sequel to Larry Horsfield's earlier text adventure Axe of Kolt.

462367.overview: A port of Fire 'N Ice, the sequel to Solomon's Key.

462983.overview: The old bytes tell of a forgotten tower hiding a treasure from another era. A time of rubber keys, endless loading screens, and pixel dreams on cassette tapes. Only a brave few have dared to enter… the Sinclair Tower. Do you accept the challenge?

463472.overview:
Heralded by the strains of the theme tune to 'The Good, The Bad And The Ugly',
Show Down (coming to us courtesy of Artic Computing) is an early example of a
cowboy gunfight.

 To move upwards, use any key from 6 to 0 on the top row and any key from Y to
P on the second row will move you down again. The all-important fire button 
can be any key from B to SPACE on the bottom row. It can be used as a one or a
two player game, but be careful if you decide to fight the Spectrum - it proves to be a more than accomplished gunslinger.

 To type in the code needed to generate the user-defined graphics required for
Show Down, you should first type in the line of Basic shown below (line 100).
When you have done this, RUN the program anf type in the graphics code star-
ting with the top line and moving onto the second line and so on; in this ca-
se you should type in 0,0,1,6,12, etc. (where a comma denotes your pressing 
the ENTER key).

 Once you have entered all 168 pieces of code, you should BREAK into the pro-
gram and type NEW. All the user-defined graphics will then be stored above 
RAMTOP, and can be typed in in Graphics mode where required in the program.

463712.overview:
A competitive game for two ... Spectrum Bowls is designed to mirror the conventional game of 'Singles' Bowls.  You may choose to play 'First to 21', or a shorter game; 'First to 10'.

As in real life, you must choose your direction. The bowl always curves towards the centre as it slows down and you choose the weight, or strength of your shot.

Bowls is a rare simulation of the game of lawn bowls rather than the more common 'ten-pin' variety.

463714.overview: Sub Chase is a variant of the arcade game Depthcharge. The player is in control of a destroyer that can be moved left and right along surface of the ocean. Beneath, submarines will appear at different depths on the left and traverse the screen. The aim of the game is to destroy a set number of submarines by dropping depth charges. This is done by pressing the keys 1 to 9 where the number represents the depth where the charge will explode. It is possible to drop up to four depth charges at a time but the number of charges available is limited. Submarines shoot missiles which have to be avoided since the destroyer will be destroyed if hit. It's also necessary to avoid backing into one's own charges.

463932.overview: Gobble up dots, and any bonus that appears below the den, but avoid being eaten by the ghosts.  When you eat a dot the ghosts turn blue for a few seconds and you can eat them.

463933.overview:
You have 90 seconds to avoid enemy mines and destroy the submarines with depthcharges.

Based on the arcade game Depth Charge.

463976.overview:
You must amass a score of at least 5000 and to defeat the enemy you must also obtain hits of at least 1000 points. (Bomber = 20 points and Hunter= 100 points).

You obtain no points for hitting asteroids. The score is of TIME + TWICE HITS.

REMEMBER, TIME IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN HITS

463997.overview:
Star Trade is an intergalactic version of Monopoly with a few variations which allows between one and nine players to take part alongside a computer opponent.

Players move around the galaxy board, buying and selling properties and ultimately trying to eliminate their opponents.

464073.overview:
First it is important to realise that Spectrum Bridge Tutor is not a bridge playing program in the true sense. It is an interactive tutor comprised of a series of hands especially designed to illustrate particular aspects of bidding and card play. Because it is a Tutor only one bid, or card, ie, the correct one, can be made or played at each turn. This is not to say that another bid or card is incorrect but that it is not the recommended bid or card to lead through the aspect being illustrated.

The 40 hands, on both the Beginners and Advanced tapes, are independent of each other and there are no part-game scores carried from one hand to another.

The bidding system used is Acol, including a strong INT (16 to 18 points) opening at all times. The Blackwood and Stayman conventions are also used where appropriate. You are always South, and if dealer, you will open bidding.

For bidding, the display indicates the dealer, gives a bidding chart, and shows your hand. For the card play the display shows your hand again at the bottom of the table and North's hand at the top. Each card, as it is played, is displayed on the table. The display also shows the deal (hand) number, the contract and the number of tricks taken by North/South and East/West and who won the last trick.

At the end of card play an explanation is given of the bidding and card play. West and East hands are not shows in order to encourage you to picture the hands that they may hold from the evidence of your own and North's hand, any bids that they may have made and their play.

After the explanation you have the following options: re-read the explanation; replay the hand; load the next hand.

464150.overview:
You have been rendered Spellbound!

Griselda the Necromancer has cast you into the skin of a toad.  As such you are the prisoner of Griselda and a pet spider Manfred... unless you can escape!

But once out of your chains you still have not escaped Griselda's clutches.  As you raced down the steps of the fortress to freedom you have to dodge the powerful spells sent after you.  Devils chase down the steps behind you, a skeleton will track your every move, ghosts haunt you from the sidelines of the action.  And each time you seem to have completed your escape, Griselda drags you back to make you try again.

464975.overview: The life of the last dragon of Beardopolis is threatened by magical springs whose water can extinguish any dragon's fire. Only by eliminating the magical springs will our protagonist be safe. Face a multitude of traps and enemies. Remember, fire is your ally and water will kill you.

469787.overview:
In this mini adventure (demo of the Retro Adventure Game Maker parser) you take on the role of Bull, the head of security at the Empire's secret base located on planet NAS III, whom we already met in Project Starwash.

In theory, your job is to oversee defense protocols, anticipate external and internal threats with military precision, and ensure the proper functioning of security systems. All very solemn, very official, and very much in line with imperial rhetoric.

In practice, much of your day is spent on routine and absurdly boring tasks that other members of the base avoid with surprising efficiency and that, for some reason, always end up being your responsibility.

However, you have a mission that is far above any report, protocol, or external threat: to beat your teammates at cards once and for all.

After a long string of defeats and humiliations, you've decided enough is enough. This is the day. There are no excuses, no distractions, and no second chances.

Welcome to Starwash: The Final Mission.

470743.overview: From the Valley of Ecos, Syrion ventures into ancient lands following the legend of the lost tomb of Nefertiti. To find it, he must gather the six sacred stones. On his journey, he will face spear guardians, moving statues, cursed mummies, pharaonic bats, and monks who guard the secrets of the past. Each stone he recovers brings him closer to his final destiny but also to ever deadlier dangers. Only when Syrion unites the Six Stones of Nefertiti will he be able to open the tomb, unveil its ancestral power.

471046.overview:
Choose from 12 legendary fighters and battle your way across the world in a series of one-on-one, best-of-three fights to achieve the glory and title of Sweet Fightin' Champion... or go head to head with your friends in 2-player mode!

Unofficial homage for the ZX Spectrum 128K, celebrating 35 years of the two-player fighting game which shaped the genre!

471239.overview:
You must direct Sid, your snake, to eat the flies and bugs, but beware of the mushrooms - they are deadly. 

His tail grows all the time. You must prevent him from eating his tail and colliding with walls.

471240.overview: Super Digger is a rudimentary 'Panic' clone for the ZX Spectrum - old as part of a compilation with 'Chase' (a 'Head On' clone).

471247.overview:
You are the captain of the anti-submarine frigate "Anachronous" ... Your task is to destroy the soviet "Yankee" class sub., as seen on your sonar display. 

A 'Real Time' submarine hunt Simulation.

471574.overview:
Trivial Snooker on your computer. Snookered is a quiz game with a snooker backdrop. You start off attempting to pot a red ball, the computer will ask you a red ball question, which are general knowledge, not too difficult and worth - like the red ball in snooker - ONE point. The computer will show four answers (A, B, C or D) and you must choose the correct one. If you do then the red ball will be potted and you will move onto a colour of your choice (Yellow, Blue or Black); these  questions are worth the amount corresponding to the snooker ball of that colour - 2, 5 or 7 and are in an ascending order of difficulty and a lower time limit.

Once you have answered a colour ball question it's back onto a red ball, then a colour and so on. The game ends when you have potted 16 red snooker balls or when you have answered two questions incorrectly.

474318.overview: SOS - Save Our Souls: a signal dreaded by all; the final signal to indicate that lives are in peril. In SOS you have to captain a space ship to the ground and rescue the stranded humans below. But all is not as simple as it sounds. You have to ward off attacking aliens and meteors every step of the way up and down and should you not dock with the mother ship properly your precious human cargo is flung to the ground - not the best testament to your piloting skills.

474348.overview:
Morten’s tumbled into the under city and endless maze of dripping tunnels, echoing metal, and rushing black water and the concert countdown has already begun. It’s up to you to lead him out before the first chord hits.

Dodge swarms of crackling, radioactive rats that sap your speed, weave past pulsing, toxic mushrooms that poison your stride and shut down your jump, and find the fastest, sneakiest route back to the surface. 

Every second matters.

Every turn could be a trap. Guide Morten through the sewers, outsmart the hazards, and make it to the stage in time to bring the house down.

474396.overview:
The concluding part of Savage Island, this continues exactly where the other game leaves off. It includes a mysterious code sheet which you will be able to decipher upon completing the game, revealing the ultimate secret of the island. After struggling through part one, you have the consolation of knowing it is half over.

This concludes the two part adventure. It requires you have completed part one (#10) and have received the password.

474494.overview: Welcome to S1NCLA1R C1TY, a metropolis that once lived through a golden age, but now lies in the shadow of despair due to the dark influence of the CPC Corporation after the disappearance of its illustrious founder. The streets whisper sadness. The city is a maze of betrayals and unexpected alliances, wrapped in the nostalgia of a clever and brilliant technological era, with the C5 electric motorcycles, Black Watch electronic watches, and the popular ZX Spectrum computers. Amidst this decay, some citizens cling to that golden age, fighting tenaciously for the city’s rebirth. These brave individuals keep the flame of resistance alive, yearning for the return of the days of glory and rejecting the dark rule of the CPC Corporation. You are Zeta, a former inhabitant of the city who returns to reunite with your old friends. Will you join the cause?
